title: [Master]-Purchase invoice in USD with deferral shows 0 "Amount LCY" in Deferral Schedule View"
summary: Purchase invoices in foreign currency now correctly display the Amount LCY field in the Deferral Schedule view instead of showing zero values.
key_points: Fixed incorrect Amount LCY calculation for deferrals on purchase invoices using foreign currency
Updated Deferral Utilities codeunit to handle currency conversion properly
Added test cases across multiple localizations to verify the fix
Ensures deferral schedules accurately reflect local currency amounts
